name: Enfilading Fire [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
Your ranged attacks take advantage of the flanking maneuvers of allies.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, one other teamwork feat.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus on ranged attacks made against a foe flanked by 1 or more allies.
